main_text.p: שוך Ch. & Syr. Fudit, effudit, Idē quod אשר & שרא & שיר, שר * Vide in שרד.
שוח Apparuit, exortum est, Prover. 27.25. Sic quoque Syr. Matth. 13.5.
שוח Ch. Curvari, incurvari, incurvare se, Psalm. 10. 10. Aphel Syr. Audacem, audentem esse, audere, 2. ad Cor. 10.2. ad Philip. 1.14. Part. plur. Audaces, 1. ad Thessal. 4.6.
שוחתא, שוחא, שוח Chal. Fossa, fovea: vastitas, vastatio. Jobi 30.3. Hebr. שואה. Vide & שחת.
שיחי Ch. Torcularia, Zach. 14.10. Vide & שיח.
* שוח Hebr. Meditari, Eloqui. Hinc שוחא Ch. Loquacitas, confabulatio, Prov. 23.29.

שוט Ch. Itare, circuire, peragrare, discurrere, accurrere, ut Hebr. Jobi 1.7. Num. 11.8. Sulcare, remigare, Ezech. 27.6.8. Natare, Jesa. 25.11. Supernatare, exundare, Threm. 3.54: Item Chal. & Syr. Spernere, aspernari, contemnere, despicere, vilipendere: contemptum, levem esse, vel fieri. Ex Pahel participium הוו משוטטין Fuerunt currentes, id est conversae, respicientes, Genes. 22.10. in Targ. Hieros. Aphel אשיט Sprevit, contempsit. Ithpehal אתשוט Sperni, contemni, despici: Syr. Partic. ܡܫܬܐܠܐ Contemnitur, Act. 19.27.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldean words are printed in their own scripts; the transcription of vocalised Hebrew and Syriac forms is approximate. Faint show-through from the reverse page was disregarded.
